about.short: Full-stack developer with hands-on experience building production web applications using React, Node.js, and MySQL. I pair clean engineering with n8n automation and SEO know-how to ship products that don't just work, they grow.
about.long: I'm a BSc CSIT graduate with internship and industry experience covering full-stack development, workflow automation, QA, and SEO. My recent work includes architecting a hospital management system at Synthbit Group Pvt. Ltd. and driving SEO and automation initiatives at a media and marketing company. I'm comfortable owning a feature from database schema to deployed UI, and I take real pride in code that's tested, indexable, and easy for the next developer to read.
